name: inloop
description: Stay in the loop with the code your agent writes. Before each change Claude writes a short, structured note: what it does, why, its parameters and why each new class or function exists. You read the notes live while Claude works and later as a review page, in the language you choose.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of inloop's notes and review page, as a name or a code (English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Nederlands, tr, de, nl ...). It does not depend on the language you chat in.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: How much the notes explain. brief: what and why. standard: also the parameters that are not obvious, comments on the lines a reader would stop at, and why each new class or function exists. deep: also every parameter, comments on most changed lines, and links to official documentation.

adhd.title: ADHD-friendly notes
adhd.description: on: notes put the point first, use short lines and bold key words, and explain every term, symbol and parameter in plain words with an example from the code. It changes how notes are written, not how much they explain.
